entities.name: Plains of Urlan
entities.description: Northern plains of Stonehaven in western Corondor, crossed by the Tenamis River and home to the ziggurat city of Hamath.

entities.name: House Kavrel
entities.description: House that ruled the Plains of Urlan before the Fall of Arathoxia.

entities.name: Fall of Arathoxia
entities.description: Event after which House Kavrel lost the plains.

entities.name: Tenamis River
entities.description: River crossing the Plains of Urlan.

entities.name: Hamath
entities.description: Ziggurat city on the Plains of Urlan.

relations.quote: The Plains of Urlan (ER-lahn) are plains in Stonehaven

relations.note: House Kavrel held the plains as its domain before the Fall of Arathoxia.
relations.quote: Before the Fall of Arathoxia , they were the domain of House Kavrel .
